# Potato: Species Guidance

Cultivated potato is commonly autotetraploid and clonally propagated. A diploid
simulation can be a useful simplified scenario, but it must be labeled as such.
For a realistic breeding design, specify ploidy, allele dosage representation,
multivalent versus bivalent pairing assumptions, clonal propagation, and
parental pedigree. Do not use diploid Mendelian genotype-frequency expectations
for a tetraploid model.
